t: r/AskAnAmerican on Reddit: Where you guys buy house goods (Decor, kitchen, bath, furnitures etc)?
s: March 3, 2025 - I like buying art directly from the artists whenever I can. For things like towels, bedding, etc. I normally just shop at Walmart. ... Thrift shops, estate sales. ... I’m not sure. It just arrives on the doorstep ... Some online, some in retail stores. I like Ikea, Kohl's, Macy's, resale shops, Craigslist/Facebook Marketplace. And sometimes friends or family will give me things I need they don't use anymore. ... Target, Home Goods, Goodwill, occasionally IKEA.
